	local function showTrackPreview(trackId: string)

			else string.format("SOLO • 1 PLAYER • %d %s",track.TargetLaps,if track.TargetLaps==1 then "LAP" else "LAPS")
		-- A nonblocking silhouette is present until the approved image is ready.
		-- A missing/denied asset keeps this fallback; no launch/selection gate.
		local ok,fallback = pcall(function()
			local definition = TrackGeometry.getDefinition(track.GeometryId)
			assert(definition,"Track preview geometry missing")
			return TrackMapRenderer.create(trackImageArea,definition,false,track.PreviewRotationDegrees)
		end)
		if ok then

			end
		end
		mapPanel:SetAttribute("PreviewStatus",if ok then "FALLBACK_2D" else "NEUTRAL")
		trackImage.Image = track.PreviewImageAssetId or ""
		syncTrackImage()
		-- Some cached textures become loaded without an IsLoaded notification.
		-- One delayed reconciliation per selection avoids a render/polling loop.
		task.delay(1, function()

		end)
		local asset = trackImage.Image
		if asset ~= "" and not trackImageRequests[asset] and ContentProvider.PreloadAsync then
			-- At most one nonblocking request per catalog image for this UI lifetime.
			trackImageRequests[asset] = "PENDING"
			task.spawn(function()
				local loaded, loadError = pcall(function()
					ContentProvider:PreloadAsync({asset}, function(_, status)
						trackImageRequests[asset] = if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then "SUCCESS" else "FAILED"
						if gui.Parent and trackMapKey and trackImage.Image == asset then syncTrackImage() end
					end)

		end
	end

	touchActions.throttle = if throttle == throttle then math.clamp(throttle, -1, 1) else 0
	touchActions.steering = if steering == steering then math.clamp(steering, -1, 1) else 0

function KartInputController.start()
	local remoteEvent = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(KartConfig.REMOTE_EVENT_NAME) :: RemoteEvent
	raceItemRemote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("RaceItemControl") :: RemoteEvent
	local itemKeyDown = false
	local lastThrottle = 0
	local lastSteering = 0
	local lastDriftRequested = false
	local timeSinceSend = KartConfig.INPUT_SEND_INTERVAL
	local wasDriving = false

	local function sendInput(force: boolean, neutral: boolean?)
		local driving = isDrivingPrototypeKart()
		local throttle, steering, driftRequested = getInputAxes()

		if not driving or neutral then
			throttle = 0
			steering = 0
			driftRequested = false
		end

		local changed = throttle ~= lastThrottle
			or steering ~= lastSteering
			or driftRequested ~= lastDriftRequested
			or driving ~= wasDriving
		if changed or (force and driving) then
			remoteEvent:FireServer(throttle, steering, driftRequested)
			lastThrottle = throttle
			lastSteering = steering
			lastDriftRequested = driftRequested
			wasDriving = driving
			timeSinceSend = 0
		end
	end

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input: InputObject, gameProcessed: boolean)
		local slot = if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.One then 1
			elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Two then 2
			elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Three then 3
			elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Four then 4 else nil
		if slot then
			local selection = Slots.get(Players.LocalPlayer, slot)
			if selection and not gameProcessed then KartInputController.selectRaceItem(selection) end
			return
		end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then
			if not itemKeyDown and not gameProcessed then KartInputController.useRaceItem() end
			itemKeyDown = true
			return
		end
		if not controlKeys[input.KeyCode] then
			return
		end
		if gameProcessed and not isDrivingPrototypeKart() then
			return
		end

		sendInput(true)
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input: InputObject)
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Q then itemKeyDown = false; return end
		if not controlKeys[input.KeyCode] then
			return
		end

		sendInput(true)
	end)

	UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
		itemKeyDown = false
		KartInputController.resetTouchActions()
		sendInput(true, true)
		if KartConfig.DEBUG_TELEMETRY then
			print("[KartInput] window focus released")
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.WindowFocused:Connect(function()
		sendInput(true)
		if KartConfig.DEBUG_TELEMETRY then
			print("[KartInput] window focused")
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.TextBoxFocused:Connect(function()
		sendInput(true)
		if KartConfig.DEBUG_TELEMETRY then
			print("[KartInput] text box focused")
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.TextBoxFocusReleased:Connect(function()
		sendInput(true)
		if KartConfig.DEBUG_TELEMETRY then
			print("[KartInput] text box focus released")
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
		if touchUpdate then touchUpdate(deltaTime) end
		timeSinceSend += deltaTime
		if timeSinceSend >= KartConfig.INPUT_SEND_INTERVAL then
			sendInput(true)
		else
			sendInput(false)
		end
	end)

	print("[RobloxKart] Kart controller ready")
end

return KartInputController

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local KartVisualMotionController = {}
local started = false
local STEER_MAX = math.rad(25)
local STEER_RESPONSE = 10

local function getKart(seatPart: BasePart?): Model?
	if not seatPart or seatPart:GetAttribute("PrototypeKartSeat") ~= true then
		return nil
	end
	local kart = seatPart.Parent
	if kart and kart:IsA("Model") and kart:GetAttribute("PrototypeKart") == true then
		return kart
	end
	return nil
end

function KartVisualMotionController.start()
	if started then
		return
	end
	started = true

	local player = Players.LocalPlayer
	local activeKart: Model? = nil
	local activeSeat: BasePart? = nil
	local activeChassis: BasePart? = nil
	local wheels = {}
	local steeringMotor: Motor6D? = nil
	local currentSteer = 0
	local currentHumanoid: Humanoid? = nil
	local seatedConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local seatPartConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local simulationConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local destroyingConnection: RBXScriptConnection? = nil
	local seatCheckElapsed = 0

	local function detach()
		if simulationConnection then
			simulationConnection:Disconnect()
			simulationConnection = nil
		end
		if destroyingConnection then
			destroyingConnection:Disconnect()
			destroyingConnection = nil
		end
		for _, wheel in wheels do
			if wheel.motor.Parent then
				wheel.motor.Transform = CFrame.identity
			end
		end
		if steeringMotor and steeringMotor.Parent then
			steeringMotor.Transform = CFrame.identity
		end
		steeringMotor = nil
		table.clear(wheels)
		activeKart = nil
		activeSeat = nil
		activeChassis = nil
		currentSteer = 0
	end

	local function attach(seatPart: BasePart?, attempt: number?)
		local kart = getKart(seatPart)
		if kart == activeKart and seatPart == activeSeat then
			return
		end
		detach()
		if not kart then
			return
		end
		local function retryWhenReplicated()
			if (attempt or 0) >= 10 then
				warn("[KartVisual] Wheel joints did not replicate")
				return
			end
			task.delay(0.2, function()
				local character = player.Character
				local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart == seatPart then
					attach(seatPart, (attempt or 0) + 1)
				end
			end)
		end
		local chassis = kart:FindFirstChild("Chassis")
		local visual = kart:FindFirstChild("Visual")
		if not chassis or not chassis:IsA("BasePart") or not visual or not visual:IsA("Model") then
			retryWhenReplicated()
			return
		end
		for _, part in visual:GetDescendants() do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				local role = part:GetAttribute("VisualMotionRole")
				local motor = part:FindFirstChild("VisualMotor")
				local radius = part:GetAttribute("WheelRadius")
				if (role == "FrontWheel" or role == "RearWheel") and motor and motor:IsA("Motor6D")
					and type(radius) == "number" and radius > 0 then
					table.insert(wheels, {
						motor = motor,
						front = role == "FrontWheel",
						radius = radius,
						angle = 0,
					})
				elseif role == "SteeringWheel" and motor and motor:IsA("Motor6D") then
					steeringMotor = motor
				end
			end
		end
		if #wheels ~= 4 or not steeringMotor then
			steeringMotor = nil
			table.clear(wheels)
			retryWhenReplicated()
			return
		end

		activeKart = kart
		activeSeat = seatPart
		activeChassis = chassis
		destroyingConnection = kart.Destroying:Connect(detach)
		simulationConnection = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
			if not activeChassis or not activeChassis.Parent then
				detach()
				return
			end
			local velocity = activeChassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			local forwardSpeed = velocity:Dot(activeChassis.CFrame.LookVector)
			local steering = kart:GetAttribute("KartVisualSteering")
			local targetSteer = if kart:GetAttribute("RaceControlsLocked") == true then 0
				elseif type(steering) == "number" then -math.clamp(steering, -1, 1) * STEER_MAX
				else 0
			currentSteer += (targetSteer - currentSteer) * (1 - math.exp(-STEER_RESPONSE * deltaTime))
			if steeringMotor then
				steeringMotor.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -currentSteer * 1.5)
			end
			for _, wheel in wheels do
				if math.abs(forwardSpeed) > 0.05 then
					wheel.angle = (wheel.angle + forwardSpeed / wheel.radius * deltaTime) % (2 * math.pi)
				end
				local yaw = if wheel.front then currentSteer else 0
				wheel.motor.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(wheel.angle, 0, 0)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function bindCharacter(character: Model)
		detach()
		if seatedConnection then
			seatedConnection:Disconnect()
			seatedConnection = nil
		end
		if seatPartConnection then
			seatPartConnection:Disconnect()
			seatPartConnection = nil
		end
		local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
		if player.Character ~= character then
			return
		end
		currentHumanoid = humanoid
		seatedConnection = humanoid.Seated:Connect(function()
			attach(humanoid.SeatPart)
		end)
		seatPartConnection = humanoid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("SeatPart"):Connect(function()
			attach(humanoid.SeatPart)
		end)
		attach(humanoid.SeatPart)
	end

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
		seatCheckElapsed += deltaTime
		if seatCheckElapsed < 0.25 then
			return
		end
		seatCheckElapsed = 0
		local humanoid = currentHumanoid
		local seatPart = humanoid and humanoid.SeatPart
		if seatPart ~= activeSeat then
			attach(seatPart)
		end
	end)

	player.CharacterAdded:Connect(bindCharacter)
	player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
		detach()
		if seatedConnection then
			seatedConnection:Disconnect()
			seatedConnection = nil
		end
		if seatPartConnection then
			seatPartConnection:Disconnect()
			seatPartConnection = nil
		end
		currentHumanoid = nil
	end)
	if player.Character then
		task.spawn(bindCharacter, player.Character)
	end
end

return KartVisualMotionController

		for _, c in kartConnections do c:Disconnect() end
		table.clear(kartConnections)
		currentKart = value
		reset()
		if value then

				table.insert(kartConnections, value:GetAttributeChangedSignal(key):Connect(reset))

		end

		local activeKart = kart()

		local gridCFrame = CFrame.new(0, groundTop + 1.75, 0) * track.GridSlots[slotIndex]
		readyPending[player] = true
		reservedSlots[player] = slotIndex
		local built, buildError = pcall(TrackBuilder.build, prototype, track, groundTop)
		if not built then
			readyPending[player] = nil
			releaseSlot(player)
			player:SetAttribute("RaceEntryError", "Track unavailable")
			warn("[Garage] Track build failed: " .. tostring(buildError))
			return
		end
		local context = PrototypeWorld.acquireKartContext(player, gridCFrame, kartSelection.Id)
		if not context then
			readyPending[player] = nil
			releaseSlot(player)
			player:SetAttribute("RaceEntryError", "Kart unavailable")
			return
		end
		local kart, seat = context.kart, context.seat
		if seat.Occupant then
			readyPending[player] = nil
			releaseSlot(player)
			player:SetAttribute("RaceEntryError", "Kart in use")
			return
		end

		player:SetAttribute("RaceEntryError", "")
		player:SetAttribute("SelectedDriverId", driverId)
		player:SetAttribute("SelectedKartId", kartId)
		player:SetAttribute("SelectedTrackId", trackId)
		player:SetAttribute("RaceMaxPlayers", track.MaxPlayers)
		player:SetAttribute("RaceMode", mode)
		readyOrder += 1
		player:SetAttribute("ReadyOrder", readyOrder)
		player:SetAttribute("GridSlot", slotIndex)
		player:SetAttribute("RaceState", "PRE_RACE")
		DriverAppearance.applyToCharacter(character, driver)
		local visual = kart:FindFirstChild("Visual")
		if visual and visual:IsA("Model") then
			KartVisualFactory.applyAppearance(visual, kartSelection)
		end
		context:setSpawnCFrame(gridCFrame)
		kart:PivotTo(gridCFrame)
		root.Anchored = false
		character:PivotTo(seat.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 2.5, 0))
		seat:Sit(humanoid)
		print(string.format("[Garage] ready driver=%s kart=%s track=%s order=%d slot=%d", driverId, kartId, trackId, readyOrder, slotIndex))
		task.delay(1, function()
			readyPending[player] = nil
			if not player.Parent then
				return
			end
			if seat.Occupant == humanoid then
				print(string.format("[Garage] driver seated at grid slot=%d", slotIndex))
			elseif player:GetAttribute("RaceState") == "PRE_RACE" then
				player:SetAttribute("RaceEntryError", "Seat failed; try Ready again")
				player:SetAttribute("RaceState", "GARAGE")
				PrototypeWorld.releaseKartContext(player)
			end
		end)
	end

	local function validInvite(host: Player, target: Player, session): boolean
		local track = TrackCatalog.Entries[session.trackId]
		return host ~= target and host.Parent == Players and target.Parent == Players
			and session.phase == "WAITING" and track ~= nil and track.MatchType == "PUBLIC_RACE"
			and session.hostUserId == host.UserId and session:contains(host)
			and session:count() < track.MaxPlayers and not session:contains(target)
			and target:GetAttribute("RaceState") == "GARAGE"
	end

	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, action: unknown, first: unknown, second: unknown, third: unknown)
		if action == "SelectKart" then
			if Workspace:GetAttribute("KDMServerRole") ~= "HUB" or player.Parent ~= Players
				or player:GetAttribute("RaceState") ~= "GARAGE" or readyPending[player]
				or player:GetAttribute("KDMRoutePending") == "RACE_LAUNCH"
				or type(first) ~= "string" or not KartCatalog.Entries[first] then
				remote:FireClient(player, "KartSelectionRejected")
				return
			end
			player:SetAttribute("SelectedKartId", first)
			remote:FireClient(player, "KartSelected", first)
		elseif action == "Ready" then
			ready(player, first, player:GetAttribute("SelectedKartId") or KartCatalog.DefaultId, third)
		elseif action == "Invite" and type(first) == "number" and first > 0 and first % 1 == 0 then
			if Workspace:GetAttribute("KDMServerRole")=="RACE" then return end
			local target = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(first)
			local session = RaceSession.active()
			if not target or not session or not validInvite(player, target, session) then
				remote:FireClient(player,"InviteFailed",{targetUserId=first,requestId=second}); return
			end
			local previous = pendingInvites[target]
			local now = os.clock()
			if previous and previous.hostUserId == player.UserId and previous.sessionId == session.id
				and previous.roundId == session.roundId and now - previous.sentAt < 30 then
				remote:FireClient(player,"InviteSent",{targetUserId=first,requestId=second,expiresAt=previous.expiresAt}); return
			end
			pendingInvites[target] = { hostUserId = player.UserId, sessionId = session.id,
				roundId = session.roundId, trackId = session.trackId, sentAt = now, expiresAt=os.time()+30 }
			remote:FireClient(target, "Invite", player.DisplayName, session.trackId,
				session:count(), TrackCatalog.Entries[session.trackId].MaxPlayers)
			remote:FireClient(player,"InviteSent",{targetUserId=first,requestId=second,expiresAt=pendingInvites[target].expiresAt})
		elseif action == "DeclineInvite" then
			local invitation=pendingInvites[player]
			local host=invitation and Players:GetPlayerByUserId(invitation.hostUserId)
			if host then remote:FireClient(host,"InviteDeclined",{targetUserId=player.UserId}) end
			pendingInvites[player] = nil
		elseif action == "JoinInvite" then
			local invitation = pendingInvites[player]
			pendingInvites[player] = nil
			if not invitation then return end
			local session = RaceSession.active()
			local host = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(invitation.hostUserId)
			if not session or session.id ~= invitation.sessionId or session.roundId ~= invitation.roundId
				or session.trackId ~= invitation.trackId or os.clock() - invitation.sentAt > 30
				or not host or not validInvite(host, player, session) then
				remote:FireClient(player, "InviteExpired")
				return
			end
			ready(player, first, player:GetAttribute("SelectedKartId") or KartCatalog.DefaultId, invitation.trackId)
		end
	end)

	print("[RobloxKart] Garage controller ready")
end

return GarageController

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local MemoryStoreService = game:GetService("MemoryStoreService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local TrackCatalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("TrackCatalog"))
local DriverCatalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("DriverCatalog"))
local KartCatalog = require(Shared:WaitForChild("KartCatalog"))
local LobbyTitleService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("LobbyTitleService"))
local ActiveMatchDirectory = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("ActiveMatchDirectory"))
local RoomSocialDirectory = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("RoomSocialDirectory"))
local RaceLaunchPayload = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("RaceLaunchPayload"))
local RaceLaunchService = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("RaceLaunchService"))

local MatchRoomService = {}
local function publicTrack(trackId)
	local track = if type(trackId) == "string" then TrackCatalog.Entries[trackId] else nil
	return if track and track.MatchType == "PUBLIC_RACE" and track.MaxPlayers >= 1 then track else nil
end
local directory = ActiveMatchDirectory.new(MemoryStoreService:GetSortedMap(ActiveMatchDirectory.MAP_NAME))
local social = RoomSocialDirectory.new(
	MemoryStoreService:GetSortedMap(RoomSocialDirectory.PRESENCE_MAP),
	MemoryStoreService:GetHashMap(RoomSocialDirectory.INVITE_MAP))
local browsing, selections, membership, launched, creating = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
local cachedRooms, remote, started, directoryStale = {}, nil, false, false

local function eligible(player)
	return player and player.Parent == Players and player:GetAttribute("RaceState") == "GARAGE"
		and player:GetAttribute("KDMRoutePending") ~= "RACE_LAUNCH"
end

local function choose(player, driverId, kartId, trackId)
	if type(driverId) ~= "string" or type(kartId) ~= "string"
		or not publicTrack(trackId) or not DriverCatalog.Entries[driverId] or not KartCatalog.Entries[kartId] then return false end
	selections[player.UserId] = { driverId = driverId, kartId = kartId, trackId = trackId }
	return true
end

local function memberFor(player, priority)
	local selected = selections[player.UserId]
	return { userId = player.UserId, name = if player.DisplayName and player.DisplayName~="" then player.DisplayName else player.Name,
		driverId = selected.driverId, kartId = selected.kartId,
		hubJobId = game.JobId, queuedAt = DateTime.now().UnixTimestampMillis, priority = priority or 3,
		admissionToken = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false) }
end

local function findCached(roomId)
	for _, record in cachedRooms do if record.roomId == roomId then return record end end
end

local function snapshotFor(player)
	local own = membership[player.UserId]
	local rooms = {}
	local selected = selections[player.UserId]
	for _, record in cachedRooms do
		if selected and record.trackId == selected.trackId then table.insert(rooms, directory:display(record)) end
	end
	local ownRoom
	if own and own.kind == "QUEUED" then
		local record = findCached(own.roomId)
		if record then
			ownRoom = directory:display(record)
			ownRoom.membershipKind = "QUEUED"
			for index, member in record.queued do
				if member.userId == player.UserId then ownRoom.queuePosition = index; break end
			end
			if not ownRoom.queuePosition then
				for _, member in record.stagedMembers or {} do
					if member.userId == player.UserId then ownRoom.nextRoundStarting = true; break end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return { visible = (browsing[player.UserId] == true or ownRoom ~= nil)
		and not (own and own.kind == "STAGED"), rooms = rooms, room = ownRoom,
		directoryStale = directoryStale, trackId = if selected then selected.trackId else nil,
		trackName = if selected then TrackCatalog.Entries[selected.trackId].DisplayName else nil,
		maxPlayers = if selected then TrackCatalog.Entries[selected.trackId].MaxPlayers else nil }
end

local function broadcast()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do remote:FireClient(player, "Snapshot", snapshotFor(player)) end
end

local function refresh()
	local ok, records = pcall(function() return directory:list() end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[KDMRoom] directory listing failed: " .. tostring(records))
		directoryStale = true
		broadcast()
		return
	end
	directoryStale = false
	cachedRooms = records
	for userId, own in membership do
		if not findCached(own.roomId) then
			membership[userId] = nil
			launched[userId] = nil
			local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(userId)
			if player then
				pcall(function() social:clearInvite(userId) end)
				remote:FireClient(player, "Error", "LOBBY CLOSED - CHOOSE ANOTHER LOBBY")
			end
		end
	end
	broadcast()
end

local function errorTo(player, message)
	if player.Parent == Players then remote:FireClient(player, "Error", message) end
end

local function launchStaged(player, record, member)
	if launched[player.UserId] == member.admissionToken then return end
	if type(member.admissionExpiresAt) ~= "number"
		or member.admissionExpiresAt <= os.time() + 5 then
		local newToken = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
		local ok, updated = pcall(function()
			return directory:renewAdmission(record.roomId, player.UserId,
				member.admissionToken, newToken)
		end)
		if not ok or not updated then return end
		record = updated
		for _, staged in record.stagedMembers do
			if staged.userId == player.UserId then member = staged; break end
		end
	end
	local payload = RaceLaunchPayload.buildMatch(record.matchId, record.roomId, { member }, record.trackId)
	if not payload then return end
	payload.admissionToken = member.admissionToken
	launched[player.UserId] = member.admissionToken
	local function failed()
		if membership[player.UserId] == nil then return end
		launched[player.UserId] = nil
		local removed, updated = pcall(function() return directory:removeStaged(record.roomId, player.UserId) end)
		if not removed then
			warn("[KDMRoom] staged rollback failed: " .. tostring(updated))
			task.delay(2, function()
				local retry, retryError = pcall(function()
					directory:removeStaged(record.roomId, player.UserId)
				end)
				if not retry then warn("[KDMRoom] staged rollback retry failed: " .. tostring(retryError)) end
			end)
		end
		membership[player.UserId] = nil
		browsing[player.UserId] = true
		refresh()
		errorTo(player, "JOIN FAILED - PLEASE TRY AGAIN")
	end
	local ok = RaceLaunchService.launchMatch({ player }, payload, failed,
		record.reservedServerAccessCode)
	if not ok then failed() end
end

local function stagePlayer(player, roomId)
	local selected = selections[player.UserId]
	local found, current = pcall(function() return directory:get(roomId) end)
	if not selected or not found or not current or current.trackId ~= selected.trackId
		or not publicTrack(current.trackId) then errorTo(player, "LOBBY TRACK MISMATCH"); return false end
	local member = memberFor(player)
	local ok, record = pcall(function() return directory:stage(roomId, member, member.admissionToken, selected.trackId) end)
	if not ok or not record then
		if not ok then warn("[KDMRoom] staging failed: " .. tostring(record)) end
		local found, current = pcall(function() return directory:get(roomId) end)
		errorTo(player, if found and not current then "LOBBY CLOSED - CHOOSE ANOTHER LOBBY"
			elseif found and current and current.state ~= "WAITING" then "LOBBY STARTED - QUEUE FOR NEXT RACE"
			elseif found and current and #current.stagedMembers + #(current.stagedBots or {}) >= current.maxPlayers then "LOBBY FULL"
			else "LOBBY STATUS UPDATING...")
		return false
	end
	membership[player.UserId] = { roomId = roomId, kind = "STAGED" }
	pcall(function() social:remove(player.UserId) end)
	refresh()
	launchStaged(player, record, member)
	return true
end

local function queuePlayer(player, roomId, priority)
	local selected = selections[player.UserId]
	local found, current = pcall(function() return directory:get(roomId) end)
	if not selected or not found or not current or current.trackId ~= selected.trackId
		or not publicTrack(current.trackId) then errorTo(player, "LOBBY TRACK MISMATCH"); return false end
	local member = memberFor(player, priority)
	local ok, record = pcall(function() return directory:queue(roomId, member, selected.trackId) end)
	if not ok or not record then
		local found, current = pcall(function() return directory:get(roomId) end)
		errorTo(player, if found and not current then "LOBBY CLOSED - CHOOSE ANOTHER LOBBY"
			else "LOBBY STATUS UPDATING...")
		return false
	end
	membership[player.UserId] = { roomId = roomId, kind = "QUEUED" }
	pcall(function() social:remove(player.UserId) end)
	refresh()
	return true
end

local function createRoom(player,mode,value)
	if not eligible(player) or membership[player.UserId] or not selections[player.UserId]
		or creating[player.UserId] then return end
	local selectedTrackId = selections[player.UserId].trackId
	if not publicTrack(selectedTrackId) then return end
	local selected=selections[player.UserId]
	local selectedAttribute=player:GetAttribute("SelectedTrackId")
	creating[player.UserId] = selected
	local function clearCreating()
		if creating[player.UserId]==selected then creating[player.UserId]=nil end
	end
	local function stillEligible()
		return eligible(player) and not membership[player.UserId] and selections[player.UserId]==selected
			and player:GetAttribute("SelectedTrackId")==selectedAttribute
	end
	local resolved,kind,title=pcall(function()
		return LobbyTitleService.resolve(player,mode,value,if mode=="CUSTOM" then game:GetService("TextService") else nil)
	end)
	if not resolved or not kind then clearCreating();errorTo(player,LobbyTitleService.ERROR);return end
	if not stillEligible() then clearCreating();return end
	local reserved, code, privateId = pcall(function()
		return TeleportService:ReserveServerAsync(game.PlaceId)
	end)
	if not reserved or type(code) ~= "string" or code == "" then
		clearCreating()
		errorTo(player, "RACE SERVER UNAVAILABLE - PLEASE TRY AGAIN"); return
	end
	if not stillEligible() then
		clearCreating()
		return
	end
	local roomId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)
	local created, createError = pcall(function()
		directory:createPersistent({ id = roomId, matchId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
			trackId = selectedTrackId, hostUserId = player.UserId,
			hostName = if player.DisplayName and player.DisplayName~="" then player.DisplayName else player.Name,
			lobbyTitleKind=kind,lobbyTitle=title, maxPlayers = TrackCatalog.Entries[selectedTrackId].MaxPlayers },
			code, privateId)
	end)
	if not created then
		clearCreating()
		warn("[KDMRoom] create failed: " .. tostring(createError))
		errorTo(player, "LOBBY STATUS UPDATING...")
		return
	end
	if not stillEligible() then
		pcall(function() directory:remove(roomId) end);clearCreating();return
	end
	if not stagePlayer(player, roomId) then
		pcall(function() directory:remove(roomId) end)
	end
	clearCreating()
end

function MatchRoomService.openBrowser(player, driverId, kartId, trackId)
	if not eligible(player) or membership[player.UserId] or creating[player.UserId] or not choose(player, driverId, kartId, trackId) then return false end
	browsing[player.UserId] = true
	refresh()
	return true
end

function MatchRoomService.start()
	if started then return end
	started = true
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "MatchRoomControl"
	remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, action, first, second, third)
		local own = membership[player.UserId]
		if action == "Browse" then
			MatchRoomService.openBrowser(player, first, second, third)
		elseif action == "Back" then
			if not own then browsing[player.UserId] = nil; broadcast() end
		elseif action == "Create" then
			createRoom(player,first,second)
		elseif action == "Join" and type(first) == "string" then
			if eligible(player) and not own and selections[player.UserId] then
				stagePlayer(player, first)
			end
		elseif action == "Queue" and type(first) == "string" then
			if eligible(player) and not own and selections[player.UserId] then
				local ok, record = pcall(function() return directory:get(first) end)
				local priority = 3
				if ok and record then
					for _, userId in record.rivalUserIds or {} do
						if userId == player.UserId then priority = 2; break end
					end
					for _, member in record.currentRoundMembers or {} do
						if member.userId == player.UserId then priority = 2; break end
					end
				end
				queuePlayer(player, first, priority)
			end
		elseif action == "CancelQueue" then
			if not own or own.kind ~= "QUEUED" then return end
			pcall(function() directory:cancelQueue(own.roomId, player.UserId) end)
			pcall(function() directory:removeStaged(own.roomId, player.UserId) end)
			membership[player.UserId] = nil
			launched[player.UserId] = nil
			refresh()
		elseif action == "AcceptInvite" then
			if own or creating[player.UserId] or not eligible(player) then return end
			local ok, invite = pcall(function() return social:getInvite(player.UserId) end)
			if not ok or not invite then errorTo(player, "INVITE EXPIRED"); return end
			local found, record = pcall(function() return directory:get(invite.roomId) end)
			if not found or not record or record.hostUserId ~= invite.hostUserId
				or record.trackId ~= invite.trackId or not publicTrack(invite.trackId) then
				errorTo(player, "INVITE EXPIRED"); return
			end
			if not choose(player, first, second, invite.trackId) then return end
			pcall(function() social:clearInvite(player.UserId) end)
			if record.state == "WAITING" and #record.stagedMembers + #(record.stagedBots or {}) < record.maxPlayers then
				stagePlayer(player, record.roomId)
			else queuePlayer(player, record.roomId, 1) end
		elseif action == "DeclineInvite" then
			pcall(function() social:clearInvite(player.UserId) end)
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		local own = membership[player.UserId]
		if own and own.kind == "QUEUED" then
			pcall(function() directory:cancelQueue(own.roomId, player.UserId) end)
		elseif own and own.kind == "STAGED"
			and player:GetAttribute("KDMRoutePending") ~= "RACE_LAUNCH" then
			pcall(function() directory:removeStaged(own.roomId, player.UserId) end)
		end
		pcall(function() social:remove(player.UserId) end)
		membership[player.UserId], browsing[player.UserId] = nil, nil
		selections[player.UserId], launched[player.UserId] = nil, nil
		creating[player.UserId] = nil
	end)

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(5)
			refresh()
			for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
				if eligible(player) and not membership[player.UserId] then
					pcall(function() social:publish(player, game.JobId) end)
				else pcall(function() social:remove(player.UserId) end) end
				local own = membership[player.UserId]
				if own and own.kind == "QUEUED" then
					local record = findCached(own.roomId)
					if record then
						for _, member in record.stagedMembers or {} do
							if member.userId == player.UserId and not member.arrived then
								launchStaged(player, record, member)
								break
							end
						end
					end
				end
				local ok, invite = pcall(function() return social:getInvite(player.UserId) end)
				if ok and invite and not membership[player.UserId] and eligible(player) then
					local record = findCached(invite.roomId)
					if record and record.hostUserId == invite.hostUserId then
						remote:FireClient(player, "Invite", { roomId = invite.roomId,
							hostUserId = invite.hostUserId, hostName = invite.hostName,
							trackId = invite.trackId, state = record.state,
							lobbyTitle=directory:display(record).lobbyTitle,lobbyTitleKind=directory:display(record).lobbyTitleKind,
							count = directory:display(record).count,
							maxPlayers = record.maxPlayers })
					elseif not directoryStale then
						pcall(function() social:clearInvite(player.UserId) end)
						errorTo(player, if record then "INVITE EXPIRED"
							else "LOBBY CLOSED - CHOOSE ANOTHER LOBBY")
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	refresh()
end

return MatchRoomService

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local RaceLaunchPayload = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("RaceLaunchPayload"))

local RaceLaunchService = {}
local pending = {}
local started = false
local ERROR_TEXT = "RACE SERVER UNAVAILABLE - PLEASE TRY AGAIN"

local function fail(player, token)
	local entry = pending[player]
	if not entry or entry.token ~= token then return end
	pending[player] = nil
	if player.Parent ~= Players then return end
	player:SetAttribute("KDMRoutePending", "")
	if entry.kind == "launch" then player:SetAttribute("RaceState", "GARAGE") end
	player:SetAttribute("RaceEntryError", if RunService:IsStudio() then
		"TELEPORT TEST REQUIRES PUBLISHED ROBLOX CLIENT" else ERROR_TEXT)
	if entry.onFailure then entry.onFailure() end
end

local function watchdog(player, token)
	if player.Parent == Players and pending[player] and pending[player].token == token then
		warn(string.format("[KDMRoute] teleport watchdog user=%d kind=%s", player.UserId, pending[player].kind))
		fail(player, token)
	end
end

function RaceLaunchService.start()
	if started then return end
	started = true
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do player:SetAttribute("KDMRoutePending", "") end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player) player:SetAttribute("KDMRoutePending", "") end)
	TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(player, teleportResult, errorMessage, placeId)
		local entry = pending[player]
		warn(string.format("[KDMRoute] teleport init failed user=%d kind=%s result=%s place=%s error=%s",
			player.UserId, if entry then entry.kind else "untracked", tostring(teleportResult),
			tostring(placeId), tostring(errorMessage)))
		if entry then fail(player, entry.token) end
	end)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player) pending[player] = nil end)
end

function RaceLaunchService.launchSolo(player, trackId, driverId, kartId, onFailure)
	if player.Parent ~= Players or pending[player] then return false end
	local payload = RaceLaunchPayload.buildSolo(HttpService:GenerateGUID(false), player, trackId, driverId, kartId)
	if not payload then return false end
	local token = {}
	pending[player] = { token = token, kind = "launch", onFailure = onFailure }
	player:SetAttribute("KDMRoutePending", "RACE_LAUNCH")
	player:SetAttribute("SelectedDriverId", driverId)
	player:SetAttribute("SelectedKartId", kartId)
	player:SetAttribute("SelectedTrackId", trackId)
	player:SetAttribute("RaceEntryError", "")
	print(string.format("[KDMRoute] launch match=%s track=%s racers=1", payload.matchId, trackId))
	local options = Instance.new("TeleportOptions")
	options.ShouldReserveServer = true
	options:SetTeleportData(payload)
	-- Clear a stalled request even if TeleportAsync never returns.
	task.delay(30, function() watchdog(player, token) end)
	local ok, resultOrError = pcall(function() return TeleportService:TeleportAsync(game.PlaceId, { player }, options) end)
	if not ok then
		warn(string.format("[KDMRoute] teleport request failed user=%d track=%s error=%s",
			player.UserId, trackId, tostring(resultOrError)))
		fail(player, token)
	else
		local privatePresent = resultOrError ~= nil and type(resultOrError.PrivateServerId) == "string"
			and resultOrError.PrivateServerId ~= ""
		local codePresent = resultOrError ~= nil and type(resultOrError.ReservedServerAccessCode) == "string"
			and resultOrError.ReservedServerAccessCode ~= ""
		print(string.format("[KDMRoute] teleport accepted user=%d reserved=true privateServerId=%s accessCode=%s",
			player.UserId, if privatePresent then "present" else "unavailable",
			if codePresent then "present" else "unavailable"))
	end
	-- A successful API return can still be followed by TeleportInitFailed.
	return ok
end

function RaceLaunchService.launchMatch(players, payload, onPlayerFailure, accessCode, preserveStateOnFailure)
	if #players < 1 or (accessCode == nil and #players ~= #payload.participantUserIds) then return false end
	local listed = {}
	for _, userId in payload.participantUserIds do listed[userId] = true end
	local seen = {}
	for index, player in players do
		if player.Parent ~= Players or pending[player] or seen[player.UserId] or not listed[player.UserId]
			or (accessCode == nil and player.UserId ~= payload.participantUserIds[index]) then
			return false
		end
		seen[player.UserId] = true
	end
	local token = {}
	for _, player in players do
		local selection = payload.selections[tostring(player.UserId)]
		pending[player] = { token = token, kind = if preserveStateOnFailure then "round" else "launch", onFailure = function()
			if onPlayerFailure then onPlayerFailure(player) end
		end }
		player:SetAttribute("KDMRoutePending", "RACE_LAUNCH")
		player:SetAttribute("SelectedDriverId", selection.driverId)
		player:SetAttribute("SelectedKartId", selection.kartId)
		player:SetAttribute("SelectedTrackId", payload.trackId)
		player:SetAttribute("RaceEntryError", "")
		task.delay(30, function() watchdog(player, token) end)
	end
	local options = Instance.new("TeleportOptions")
	if accessCode then options.ReservedServerAccessCode = accessCode
	else options.ShouldReserveServer = true end
	options:SetTeleportData(payload)
	print(string.format("[KDMRoute] group launch match=%s room=%s racers=%d", payload.matchId, payload.roomId, #players))
	local ok, resultOrError = pcall(function()
		return TeleportService:TeleportAsync(game.PlaceId, players, options)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn("[KDMRoute] group teleport request failed: " .. tostring(resultOrError))
		for _, player in players do fail(player, token) end
	end
	return ok, if ok then resultOrError else nil
end

function RaceLaunchService.returnToHub(player, onFailure)
	if player.Parent ~= Players or pending[player] then return false end
	local token = {}
	pending[player] = { token = token, kind = "return", onFailure = onFailure }
	player:SetAttribute("KDMRoutePending", "HUB_RETURN")
	if not onFailure then player:SetAttribute("RaceEntryError", "") end
	task.delay(30, function() watchdog(player, token) end)
	local ok, resultOrError = pcall(function() return TeleportService:TeleportAsync(game.PlaceId, { player }) end)
	if not ok then
		warn(string.format("[KDMRoute] HUB return request failed user=%d error=%s", player.UserId, tostring(resultOrError)))
		fail(player, token)
	else
		print(string.format("[KDMRoute] HUB return accepted user=%d", player.UserId))
	end
	return ok
end

return RaceLaunchService
